title: Bethany Cemetery's road to landmark
subtitle: The city first took up landmark status for the East Austin burial ground in 1977
source: KXAN, citing city documents and Preservation Austin
alt: Timeline of landmark status for Bethany Cemetery in East Austin: founded in 1893 by and for Black Austinites, first taken up by the Historic Landmark Commission in 1977, brought forward again in 2024 but timed out, recommended by the commission in January 2026, and designated a City of Austin Landmark by City Council on Aug. 27, 2026

events.label: Bethany Cemetery is founded on Springdale Road
events.note: Started by and for Black Austinites in what is now East Austin

events.label: The Historic Landmark Commission takes up the case
events.note: City documents cite a series of postponements; it never reaches a recommendation

events.label: The nomination returns and times out
events.note: City documents blame missing case materials

events.label: The commission recommends designation
events.note: Preservation Austin brought the case with the cemetery association

events.label: City Council designates the cemetery a landmark
events.note: Council voted at its regular meeting, following the January recommendation
